status: PROPOSAL v2 (post-audit) — requires RJ sign-off on repos+tasks+bands before any run

revision.reason: Two adversarial audits flagged 6 of 10 tasks as degenerate/gimme and identified the absence of SHA-pinning as the systemic root cause (depth-1 clones drifted to HEAD, where some of the original features had already shipped, turning real tasks into no-ops).
revision.fix: All 10 repos SHA-pinned (sweep must clone --depth 1 then checkout the exact sha). The 6 degenerate/gimme tasks swapped for audited (a)-shaped probes whose NEW symbol is verified absent and whose REUSE TARGET is verified present, both at the pinned SHA. The 4 honest tasks kept (jmespath + cobra tightened). Interpretation bands UNCHANGED (locked at original sign-off).

analyzer_grounding.note: Unsupported languages emit reuse_pct:null reason:unsupported-language (reuse_analyzer.py:512). Tree-sitter upgrade in-flight (async agent 2026-06-17 09:15, NOT merged to main as of this proposal). If it lands first, go/rust repos graduate to reuse_measured:true.

sha_pinning.checkout_protocol: Sweep MUST: git clone --depth 1 <url> <dir>; git -C <dir> fetch --depth 1 origin <sha>; git -C <dir> checkout <sha>. The audited absent-symbol / present-reuse-target state is frozen at these SHAs.
sha_pinning.runner_followup: bin/heimdall-s6-sweep consumes this manifest. If the runner does not yet honor the per-repo 'sha' field, wiring it in is a follow-up task; the field is added now so the audited state is captured regardless.

spend.protocol: Stage A dry-run (slugify+records) -> measured cost report -> RJ Stage-B approval -> Stage C full sweep under 600k fail-closed, 90k per-task kill.

interpretation_bands.reuse_median_scope: reuse_measured:true repos only (8: 5 JS + 3 Py; cobra+anyhow excluded). Median is over whichever measured repos survive wave-0 preflight.

GENERALIZES.distribution_guard: no measured repo < 0.20; >=4 of the 8 measured >= 0.40

MIXED.alt_trigger: bimodal: tiny-util repos high, sprawling repos low
MIXED.action: targeted work on the weak cell (likely large-repo symbol discovery) before features

CORE_GAP.alt_trigger: >=3 measured repos emit suspected_duplicates for the named target symbol
CORE_GAP.action: halt feature work; roadmap becomes 'make cold-repo reuse real'

interpretation_bands.verdict_rule: BOTH axes must clear for GENERALIZES; working-output gate can veto a high reuse median. A low result is a FINDING, not a failure; bands do not move post-result.

wave0_preflight.sha_checkout: clone --depth 1 then checkout the pinned 'sha' before anything else; abort the repo if the SHA is unreachable
wave0_preflight.license_verify: confirm LICENSE file is MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD/ISC at the pinned SHA; on mismatch drop repo and use bench replacement
wave0_preflight.baseline_green: run the repo's own test/build command at pinned SHA on clean checkout; baseline MUST be green before any task; if red, drop + bench-replace
wave0_preflight.reuse_emit_check: for reuse_measured:true repos, confirm a reuse record with non-null reuse_pct emits on a no-op or dry diff

repos.why_probe: Tiny single-purpose util; clear internal slugify core + removeMootSeparators helper. A maxLength-truncation option must thread through the existing pipeline, not re-tokenize.
repos.task_prompt: Add a maxLength option to slugify that truncates the final slug to at most N characters without leaving a trailing separator.
repos.acceptance_cmd: npm test (xo+ava) green AND added AVA case: slugify('foo bar baz', {maxLength:7}) === 'foo-bar'

validation_at_sha.reuse_target_present: removeMootSeparators(string, separator) @ index.js:15,98; slugify() pipeline @ index.js:46 (PRESENT)

repos.why_probe: Concurrency util; a variant task must reuse the existing iterator/concurrency machinery, not rewrite it.
repos.task_prompt: Add a pMapValues helper that maps over an object's values with the same concurrency control as pMap and returns a new object.
repos.acceptance_cmd: npm test green AND added case: pMapValues({a:1,b:2}, async v=>v*2, {concurrency:1}) resolves {a:2,b:4}

repos.why_probe: Internal wrapWord/wordLengths helpers + string-width import. An ellipsis option in hard-wrap mode must reuse the existing word-wrap path and width measurement, not re-break the word.

repos.acceptance_cmd: npm test (xo+ava+tsd) green AND a case asserting a too-long word under {hard:true, ellipsis:true} ends in '…' at column width with ANSI intact

repos.acceptance_cmd: pip install -e . && pytest green AND test: Database(...).query('select 1 as a union all select 1 as a').distinct('a') yields one row
